content: Posts published on this site are the original versions. dev.to imports them from the RSS feed and points the canonical URL back here. New posts are Markdown files in content/posts. A pull request builds a preview of the site, including drafts, before anything is merged. Set draft to false when a post should go live. More about how the site is put together is on the about page .
description: Notes will live here first, then syndicate to dev.to from the RSS feed.
